name: OpenClaw
description: Autonomous AI agent with web dashboard
setup: mkdir -p /home/dev/.openclaw/logs && echo '{"gateway":{"mode":"local","auth":{"mode":"token","token":"sandbox"},"controlUi":{"allowedOrigins":["https://remolt.dev"],"allowInsecureAuth":true,"dangerouslyDisableDeviceAuth":true}}}' > /home/dev/.openclaw/openclaw.json && echo 'if [ -t 0 ] && [ ! -f /tmp/.openclaw-onboarded ]; then [ -f /dev/shm/.env ] && source /dev/shm/.env; touch /tmp/.openclaw-onboarded; openclaw onboard --accept-risk; fi' >> /home/dev/.bashrc && echo 'if ! pgrep -f "openclaw gateway" >/dev/null 2>&1; then openclaw gateway --verbose --bind lan --port 18789 > /home/dev/.openclaw/logs/gateway.log 2>&1 & fi' >> /home/dev/.bashrc
welcome:
Starting OpenClaw setup wizard...
Complete the onboard wizard, then switch to the Dashboard tab.
